description:
The Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is a significant scholarship scheme initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st August 2021. 

The primary objective of the Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is to provide financial assistance to meritorious students who belong to economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme aims to encourage students to pursue higher education and excel in their academic pursuits. 

It specifically targets students who have completed their 12th grade and are seeking admission into undergraduate courses. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to alleviate the burden of educational expenses. 

The scholarship covers various educational costs including tuition fees, examination fees, and other related expenses. 

Eligible students can receive a scholarship amount of up to ₹25,000 per year. 

This amount is disbursed directly to the educational institution where the student is enrolled. 

The scheme is designed to support students from both urban and rural backgrounds. 

To qualify for the Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana, students must meet specific eligibility criteria. 

Applicants must be residents of Madhya Pradesh. 

They must have completed their 12th grade from a recognized board of education. 

The scheme is open to students who have secured at least 75% marks in their 12th-grade examinations. 

Additionally, the annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹6 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the benefits of the scheme reach those who are genuinely in need of financial assistance. 

The application process for the Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Students must visit the official website of the Madhya Pradesh government or the dedicated scholarship portal. 

They need to create an account and fill out the application form with accurate details. 

Required documents include a copy of the 12th-grade mark sheet, proof of residence, and income certificate. 

Students must also provide their bank account details for the disbursement of the scholarship amount. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

The scholarship amount is typically disbursed within a few weeks after the verification process is completed. 

Students can expect to receive the funds at the beginning of the academic year. 

The Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is implemented by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the administration and execution of the scheme. 

For any queries or assistance, students can contact the Department of Higher Education through their official helpline. 

The helpline number is available on the official website. 

The scheme has been well-received since its launch, with thousands of students benefiting from the financial support. 

In the first year alone, over 10,000 students applied for the scholarship. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crores for the implementation of this scheme in the initial phase. 

This budget is expected to increase in subsequent years as the scheme gains popularity. 

The Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is part of a broader initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government to enhance educational opportunities for all. 

It aligns with the national goal of increasing the Gross Enrollment Ratio in higher education. 

The scheme aims to empower students from marginalized communities and promote social equity. 

By providing financial assistance, the government hopes to reduce dropout rates among students from economically weaker sections. 

The scholarship is not limited to any specific field of study. 

Students pursuing various undergraduate courses including engineering, medicine, arts, and commerce can apply. 

The scheme also encourages students to excel in their academic performance and contribute positively to society. 

In addition to financial support, the Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana aims to boost the morale of students. 

It instills a sense of confidence and motivation among young learners. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana reflects the government's commitment to education as a fundamental right. 

It underscores the importance of investing in human capital for the overall development of the state. 

The scheme is a step towards creating a knowledge-based society. 

It emphasizes the role of education in breaking the cycle of poverty. 

The Madhya Pradesh government encourages eligible students to take advantage of this opportunity. 

The scholarship not only eases financial burdens but also opens doors to better career prospects. 

Students are urged to stay informed about the application deadlines and requirements. 

The government updates the scholarship portal regularly with relevant information. 

The Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting higher education. 

It aims to create a more educated and skilled workforce in Madhya Pradesh. 

In conclusion, the Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana is a vital initiative that supports students in their educational journey. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme plays a crucial role in shaping the future of many young individuals in the state. 

Students are encouraged to apply and make the most of this opportunity for their academic and professional growth.
